proposals.evidence: Platts p. 846 distinguishes Persian-derived kam “less, little, scanty” from kām “work/desire” and Arabic interrogative kam. The existing Hindi/Urdu kam donor is also identified in Liljegren’s Palula loan analysis. Provisional immediate-donor hypothesis: Hindi/Urdu, with borrowing between neighboring Indo-Aryan languages still possible. The source establishes the lexical family, not the direction of transfer into this particular survey locality. Saved as borrowed under the user’s explicit preference to link supported families despite unresolved cross-IA transmission; audit the donor route.
